summary: Iteration 106 — Org-Type Master migration + URL-import progress endpoint tested against https://repo-blueprint-1.preview.emergentagent.com. BACKEND: 9/9 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter106_org_types_master.py — GET /api/org-types returns 7 active types sorted by sort_order with FAMILY (sort_order=2, desc='Family / household'); admin CRUD on /api/admin/org-types: POST creates custom TESTFAM_<ts>, list-admin includes it, PUT updates label+color, DELETE hard-deletes (returns status='deleted'); DELETE on system type FAMILY soft-disables (returns status='disabled', active:false, hidden from public list) and PUT active:true restores it; POST /api/hos/decisions with acting_as_context=FAMILY + life_area_id=la_personal + ask_type_id=at_choice → 200 with decision_id; bogus acting_as_context='TOTALLY_BOGUS_KEY_XYZ' → 400 with detail listing valid keys (FAMILY/INDIVIDUAL present); GET /api/url-analyze/progress/{random} returns {pct:5, label:'Starting…', status:'running'} when no doc exists. FRONTEND: After supervisor restart of expo (stale bundle on first attempt — fresh build picked up correctly), all checks pass. /admin/masters: 'Org Types' chip is FIRST tab in the bar (left-most position), clicking it renders 7 system rows with correct icons/colors and 'system' pills (Individual, Family pink #EC4899, Business Organization, Academic Organization, Non-profit Organization, Association, Government), Add flow (org-type-add-btn → label 'AutoTest Pet' → desc → org-type-icon-btn → searchable picker (search 'leaf' → org-type-icon-opt-leaf) → org-type-color-10B981 → org-type-save-btn) creates AUTOTEST_PET row; org-type-edit-AUTOTEST_PET renames to 'AutoTest Pet Edited' (verified row inner text); org-type-delete-AUTOTEST_PET + confirm 'Delete' button removes the row. Religions/Castes/Languages/Occupations etc tabs continue to function (regression OK). /tools/new-decision?module=dezider: Life Area is step 1, after selecting any area + Next, step 2 'This decision is for…' shows 7/7 dynamic cards with testIDs acting-as-INDIVIDUAL/FAMILY/BUSINESS_ORG/ACADEMIC_ORG/NONPROFIT_ORG/ASSOCIATION/GOVERNMENT — FAMILY card shows pink icon with label 'Family' and description 'Family / household'. Selecting Family + Next advances to Step 3 (Ask Type) confirming decision creation works. /tools/new-decision?module=swot spot-check: 7/7 dynamic acting-as cards present. /tools/add-solution Category step shows 7/7 'Org Types' targeting chips (testID solution-org-type-{KEY}) including solution-org-type-FAMILY. Import-progress-modal testID is wired in Step2.tsx (verified by grep — testID='import-progress-modal', import-progress-stage, import-progress-pct) and backend progress endpoint behaves correctly; live URL import was NOT executed to save LLM credits but code path is intact. No deprecated Expo packages, no SafeAreaView issues, no React Native red screens.

ui_bugs.issue: Default selected tab is 'religion' (useState('religion')) even though 'Org Types' is the FIRST chip in the TYPES array. Visually, on first load the Org Types chip is rendered as left-most but Religions is highlighted as active. Acceptance criteria say 'first tab should be Org Types' — change initial state to 'org_type' so it is selected by default when admin lands on /admin/masters.

action_items: Optional polish (LOW): in /app/frontend/app/admin/masters.tsx line 32, change useState('religion') → useState('org_type') so the new 'Org Types' tab is the default selection (matches the acceptance criteria wording 'first tab should be Org Types').

Bundler note: on first preview after deploying this iteration the rendered HTML was stale (Religions/Castes/Languages/Occupations visible but Org Types absent from DOM); a `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` fixed it. Main agent doesn't need to fix anything here, but worth noting for next deploy.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/payment_admin.py — _ensure_org_types_seed is correctly idempotent ($setOnInsert + a second $set to backfill description on legacy rows). DELETE on a system row correctly soft-disables (active:false) and the public GET filters by active:true so the row disappears from intake cards without losing existing decisions' references.

/app/frontend/src/components/admin/OrgTypesManager.tsx — Clean 303-line module with full testID coverage (org-type-add-btn, org-type-row-{KEY}, org-type-edit-{KEY}, org-type-delete-{KEY}, org-type-icon-btn, org-type-icon-search, org-type-icon-opt-{name}, org-type-color-{hex}, org-type-save-btn, org-type-label-input, org-type-desc-input). Searchable Ionicons picker uses Object.keys(Ionicons.glyphMap) and drops -sharp variants (good).
/app/backend/routes/url_analyze.py:569-576 — GET /progress/{id} default response {pct:5,label:'Starting…',status:'running'} is sensible for the brief gap between POST start and first progress write.
/app/frontend/app/admin/masters.tsx initial state — see ui_bugs above (default selected tab is religion not org_type, despite Org Types being first in TYPES).

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (all 7 org-type rows, full CRUD modal flow incl. searchable icon picker, dynamic 7-card intake for dezider+swot, 7 add-solution chips, regression tabs work) — minor polish item: default tab selection (LOW)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed created. Backend test creates TESTFAM_<unix_ts> and deletes it. Frontend test creates AUTOTEST_PET and deletes it. DB returned to clean state (verified by re-listing /admin/org-types — only the 7 system rows remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-verify cheaply: (1) Run `cd /app && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL='https://repo-blueprint-1.preview.emergentagent.com' python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter106_org_types_master.py -v` — all 9 should pass. (2) Frontend testIDs to validate: on /admin/masters click 'Org Types' chip → org-type-add-btn, org-type-row-{INDIVIDUAL,FAMILY,BUSINESS_ORG,ACADEMIC_ORG,NONPROFIT_ORG,ASSOCIATION,GOVERNMENT}, org-type-edit-{KEY}, org-type-delete-{KEY}. Modal: org-type-label-input, org-type-key-input, org-type-desc-input, org-type-icon-btn, org-type-icon-search, org-type-icon-opt-{name}, org-type-color-{hex without #}, org-type-is-org-switch, org-type-active-switch, org-type-sort-input, org-type-cancel-btn, org-type-save-btn. (3) On /tools/new-decision?module=dezider (and ?module=swot) — pick a Life Area, click Next → 7 cards with testID acting-as-{KEY}. (4) On /tools/add-solution → Type → Next → Details → Next → Category, 7 chips with testID solution-org-type-{KEY}. (5) Import progress modal testID is import-progress-modal in Step2.tsx; backend default progress response is {pct:5,label:'Starting…',status:'running'}. (6) If the /admin/masters page shows only Religions/Castes/Languages/Occupations and no Org Types chip, the Expo bundle is stale — run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and re-test after 8s.
rca_of_issue: No functional issues. Single LOW-priority polish: /app/frontend/app/admin/masters.tsx line 32 `useState('religion')` — should be `useState('org_type')` to match the spec wording 'first tab should be Org Types'. Currently the Org Types chip is rendered first in the bar but Religions is highlighted/active by default, requiring one extra tap from the admin.
